Yes,
Farmacias del Ahorro
sells consumer wearable tech and lifestyle fitness trackers like smartwatches and smart bands (such as Huawei, Xiaomi, and Redmi devices) via their online store and marketplace. However,
they do not distribute dedicated, prescription-grade medical wearables
(such as continuous glucose monitors with specialized clinical integration or FDA-cleared clinical blood pressure smartwatches), confining their medical diagnostic inventory to traditional home-use medical hardware like digital blood pressure monitors (baumanometers), pulse oximeters, and standard glucometers.
